# Report: Does X scale?
## Throughput
X sustains 12k req/s on commodity hardware in independent tests [bench.example.org/x-2024].
## Failure modes
Under partition, X favors availability and reconciles on heal [docs.x.example/consistency].
## Cost
A 3-node cluster runs ~$300/mo on current cloud pricing [cloudcalc.example/x].
## Synthesis
X fits availability-first workloads tolerant of eventual consistency; for strict serializability, prefer a CP store. Each sub-question above is answered with a primary or vendor source.
